actions.heading: Use the counter route with your registration reference
actions.essential: Only if counter collection is chosen: after completing registration, present the fictional registration reference at the fictional counter to collect the demo pack.
conditions: The citizen has chosen counter collection.
actions.explanation_hidden: The counter and locker instructions describe alternative ways to collect the same fictional pack. On this route you present the registration reference at the counter after registration; the locker route is not an additional required visit.

actions.heading: Use the locker route with your registration reference
actions.essential: Only if locker collection is chosen: after completing registration, use the fictional registration reference at the fictional locker to collect the demo pack.
conditions: The citizen has chosen locker collection.
actions.explanation_hidden: The locker route uses the registration reference after registration. Counter collection is the other alternative, not another action required after this route. The chosen route determines where you use the reference.

actions.heading: Register your collection request and keep its reference
actions.essential: Register a fictional collection request and obtain its fictional registration reference. Registration and collection both have a fictional fee of LKR 0. After registration, choose exactly one collection method: counter or locker. Use the registration reference with the chosen method. Do not perform both alternatives.
actions.explanation_hidden: Registration supplies the reference used by either collection method. Counter and locker collection are alternatives, so the reference connects registration to your chosen method; it does not mean you must visit both.

sources.text: Authored fictional scenario: the Fictional C4 Demo Office registers a collection request and issues a fictional registration reference. Registration costs LKR 0. Collection costs LKR 0 and requires that reference. Registration must be completed before either collection action. Exactly one collection alternative is chosen: present the reference at the fictional counter, or use it at the fictional locker. Counter collection applies only when the counter method is chosen. Locker collection applies only when the locker method is chosen. The alternatives are not consecutive actions. No other conditions, branches, dependencies or parallel groups exist within this complete fictional scenario.
